population: All120 S0 nominal rows and all360 saved generated inputs; fixed UID, no dropping unknown or outside rows.
independent_observations: Read both only after A and C COMPLETE seals; original observation files unchanged. Root13 visual notes sealed separately before new observation values.

nominal_join.same_state: Retain exact shared six-state observation. For D/E require each observer positive intended-part evidence, nonempty bounded integer ROI; for E require each observer positive foreign foreground/occluder evidence.
nominal_join.different_state: UNKNOWN with both states/evidence retained; do not adjudicate by model, source mask, or protected score.
nominal_join.outside: OUT_OF_FRAME retained by declared nominal target flag; never external E.
nominal_join.weak_authority: Assistant two-observer agreement is weak intended-material-part visibility, not human annotation, exact physical corner gold, deployment initializer accuracy or fresh blind evaluation.
nominal_join.ROI: Two observed integer inclusive ROI boxes remain separate weak bags. Geometry-valid union is a support selector, not material segmentation gold.

transfer_to_all360.states: S0 plus fixed query shifts S1=(0.25L,0), S2=(0,0.25L). Expected part is the same declared GTcandidate by construction.
transfer_to_all360.ROI_transform: For each observation box subtract (24,0) or (0,24) from pixel indices; do not clip/shrink or redefine feature.
transfer_to_all360.retain_D_or_E_only_if: Both nominal D/E observations agree with required evidence; every original evidence box remains fully inside 96x96, every selected pixel is strict-valid in saved RLE, declared nominal target remains inside canvas and actual crop support, generated query available. Otherwise UNKNOWN/location unsupported.
transfer_to_all360.non_D_E: Retain diagnostic state but weak loss mask false; state alone never produces external E.
transfer_to_all360.loss_masks: SOURCE_FIT D/E support-valid only become prospective weak-loss candidates; SOURCE_DEV and all descendants always excluded fit/norm. Counts refer variants of120 underlying points, not independent new scenes.

future_training: Bounded weak public-real targets may accompany existing synthetic strong targets; perfect mesh/physical-point gold is not blanket requirement. Training scope/checkpoint choice uses only SOURCE_FIT/DEV ancestry, never protected evaluations.
